_comments: One daily job → AccountingERPEngine.SyncMasterData for every credentialed company.
JobTypeID is the seeded Action type (ActionScheduledJobDriver). Cron is six fields, seconds first:
`0 0 2 * * *` = 02:00:00 UTC every day. Concurrency Skip so overlapping runs do not double-pull.
Two-path execution: when all three objects (accounts, dimensions, dimensionValues) are requested
and the CompanyIntegration has active CompanyIntegrationEntityMap rows for a connector-backed
integration, SyncMasterData delegates to MJ IntegrationEngine.RunSync; when a subset Objects
filter is supplied or no connector exists, it falls back to the direct BaseAccountingERPProvider pull.
Ships Disabled so a freshly installed host does not run unattended jobs before an administrator

fields.Name: Accounting — ERP master data (daily)
fields.Description: Pulls chart of accounts, dimensions, and dimension values from every active Company Integration (delegating full-set connector syncs to MJ IntegrationEngine.RunSync and falling back to direct provider pull for subset filters or custom providers). Posts of journal batches are a separate engine verb, not this job.
